{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
                       (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check the filtered dataset
print("Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH:", len(filtered_df))
print("Conversion rate (fraction converted):")
print(filtered_df['converted'].mean())"}
